verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me:
verses.2: Son of man, you who sit in the house of the demon, you have eyes to see, but you cannot see; you have ears to hear, but you cannot hear. For they are the house of demons.
verses.3: And you, son of Adam, were created for you by God. He made everything in the world, and he set times for them. You were moved from your place to another place, so that they might see it. But they will not be able to see it because Meri’s house is still there.
verses.4: And you will go out like all the other creatures in the day, for their eyes. And in the evening, you will also go out for their eyes, just as other creatures do.
verses.5: In their eyes, you are like a wall that they can’t break through. And so, you are trapped inside it.
verses.6: In their eyes, a veil will be lifted from your face; they will cover you with it. And you will not see the land as it truly is. You have been given over to the house of Israel.
verses.7: And I did as I was commanded. I went out, like all the others in the morning and evening. I carved out a path in the wall with my hands. I carried it forward, for their eyes to see.
verses.8: And it came to pass in the morning that the words of Jehovah were spoken to me.
verses.9: When Adam said to them, “Israel’s house, the house of Moriah, what are you doing?”
verses.10: Say to them, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah, the Creator: This man is in Jerusalem, and all the houses of Israel who are within their midst.”
verses.11: I say, I will punish them just as I did. They will be punished in the valley. They will leave there.
verses.12: And the priest who is among them will be carried into the sanctuary. He will go out through the wall, and his face will be covered with a veil, so that he cannot see the earth.
verses.13: And I spread my tent over him. Then I took him there, into a land of thorns and weeds. And she would not see it at all; she died there.
verses.14: And all those around him will be his helpers. And all his allies will support him in every situation.
verses.15: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, who scatter them among the nations and bring them into their own lands.
verses.16: And I was set free from them, from those who were among the people who had suffered from hunger and thirst. So that they could tell all their sufferings in the lands where they lived. And they would know that I am Jehovah.
verses.17: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me:
verses.18: The son of man will eat your flesh in a noise; he will drink your blood in anger and anxiety.
verses.19: And you said to the people of the land, “Thus says the Lord God: To those who dwell in Jerusalem, and to all the inhabitants of Israel, I will give them food from their own fields. They shall eat and drink, so that their land may be filled again with people.”
verses.20: And the cities that are built will be destroyed, and the land will become barren. Then you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.21: And the word of Jehovah was to me:
verses.22: What has this king done to you on the land of Israel? He said, “Let the days go on, and all those who saw it will be destroyed.”
verses.23: Therefore, say to them this: “O LORD God, I have taken this ruler away from him. I will not let him rule over Israel anymore. For it has come to pass that the days are coming when they will be destroyed.”
verses.24: For there will no longer be any beauty or charm in the houses of Israel.
verses.25: For I, Jehovah, will speak what I will say, and it will be done. Do not delay any longer. In your days, the house of Meri will speak its words, and they will be carried out, says Jehovah.
verses.26: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.27: And behold, the House of Israel says that the prophet who will see things in the distant future and in far-off times will be anointed.
verses.28: Therefore, I say to them: “O Lord Jehovah, do not delay any longer in carrying out all the things I have spoken. Please act, O Lord Jehovah!”
